{{Wireless adapter |brand=Lite-On |model=WN6603AH |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=08/14/2009 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=Yes |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=Mini PCIe (half) |if_bus_version= |if_connector_type= |form_factor= |vendor_id=168c |device_id=002e |subvendor_id=17aa |subdevice_id=30a4 |id_string= |fcc_id=PPD-AR5B97 |ic_id=4104A-AR5B97 |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR9287 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=1C:65:9D, 68:A3:C4, 74:DE:2B |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} AR5B97 version from Lite-On, Model WN6603AH.
It is used in some unknown Acer laptops.
There are different versions of this card with different OUIs. PCB is green.
OUI 1C:65:9D has only the MAC address, S/N, IC and FCC ID on the front label, next to an QR code and the FCC logo. Antenna connectors has silkscreened "A" and "B".
OUI 74:DE:2B has many approval ID's from FCC, IC, CMIIT, India, COFETEL and POSTEL on the front label next to the MAC address and S/N. It says Atheros model : AR5B97 and Ver: B, Antenna connectors has silkscreened "1" and "2".
